sources.title: Yi-Coder-9B: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Model Overview Overview Yi-Coder-9B is a specialized code language model built by 01-ai that achieves state-of-the-art coding performance with under 10 billion parameters. The model features a 128K token context window and supports 52 programming languages including Python, JavaScript, Java, C++, Go, Rust, and TypeScript.
